done_condition: Report n (closed trades), net mean bp/trade after 26bp round-turn, 95% bootstrap CI, permutation p, and DSR. Cell is DONE when a JSON artifact exists under results/cells/<symbol>_<strategy>_<horizon>.json carrying those five numbers plus git SHA. Cell is KILLED (also complete) when n<30 or CI includes 0 or permutation p>0.05. Cell is BLOCKED_NO_DATA only when the instrument has no bars at that horizon in the repo - and then the bar count must be recorded to prove it.
